name: gh_read
description: Read a GitHub issue, PR, PR diff, or issue list via gh:// or github:// URLs. Does not extend read_file (which stays network-free). Requires GITHUB_TOKEN. Examples: gh://issue/owner/repo/42, gh://pr/owner/repo/7/diff, gh://issue/owner/repo?state=open.
llm_description: Read GitHub issues/PRs via gh:// or github:// (not read_file). Needs GITHUB_TOKEN. gh://issue/o/r/n, gh://pr/o/r/n[/diff[/path]], gh://issue/o/r?state=open.
